def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Top_Three_Identity_Theft_Reports_by_Year.csv', skiprows=2)
    # The columns are: Year, Theft Type, # of Reports
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Theft Type', '# of Reports']
    # Remove rows with all NaN values
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    # Remove rows where Year is not a valid year (contains text like "The top...")
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'])
    df['# of Reports'] = df['# of Reports'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    return df

input.code:
def process(load_fraud_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_fraud_data
    cc_df = df[df['Theft Type'] == 'Credit Card']
    
    reports_2024 = cc_df[cc_df['Year'] == 2024]['# of Reports'].values[0]
    reports_2020 = cc_df[cc_df['Year'] == 2020]['# of Reports'].values[0]
    
    ratio = reports_2024 / reports_2020
    ratio_rounded = round(ratio, 4)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({'Year_2024_Reports': [reports_2024], 'Year_2020_Reports': [reports_2020], 'Ratio_2024_to_2020': [ratio_rounded]})
